# Cliffco Mortgage Bankers

> Cliffco Mortgage Bankers is a 36-year independent mortgage banker
> (NMLS #65328) headquartered in Uniondale, NY. Cliffco specializes
> in non-QM and self-employed loans, reverse mortgages, DSCR loans for
> real estate investors, and fix-and-flip financing. Cliffco is licensed
> in 32 states and operates eight branches across New York, New Jersey,
> Arizona, Minnesota, and Florida. In Florida, Cliffco operates as
> Swish Capital, Inc.

## About

- [About Cliffco](https://cliffcomortgage.com/about/): 36-year history, mission, vision, values, leadership
- [Loan Officers](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loan-officers/): NMLS-licensed loan officer directory
- [State Licensing](https://cliffcomortgage.com/licensing/): Full 32-state license details
- [NMLS Consumer Access](https://nmlsconsumeraccess.org/EntityDetails.aspx/COMPANY/65328)

## Loan Products

- [Non-QM & Self-Employed Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/non-qm-self-employed/): Bank statement, P&L, 1099, asset utilization, ITIN, foreign national
- [Reverse Mortgage (HECM and proprietary)](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/reverse-mortgage/): For homeowners 62+
- [DSCR Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/dscr/): For real estate investors; long-term and short-term rentals
- [Fix-and-Flip Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/fix-and-flip/): Hard money, ARV-based, 7–10 day close
- [Conventional Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/conventional/)
- [FHA Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/fha/)
- [VA Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/va/)
- [USDA Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/usda/)
- [Renovation Loans](https://cliffcomortgage.com/loans/renovation/)
